Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted misleading search snippets claiming Julia (daughter of Caesar and Cornelia) married Cicero and prematurely concluded the task without verification. The correct spouse—and thus Cornelia’s child-in-law—is Pompey (Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus). The error stems from relying on SERP snippets instead of confirming with authoritative sources (e.g., the actual Wikipedia page or reputable histories).
